turns.text: Maybe I could start with community college, take some general courses, and see what interests me most.
turns.zh: 也许我可以先从社区大学开始，上一些通识课，看看自己最感兴趣的是什么。

turns.text: That's not a bad idea at all.
It would be less expensive and you could explore different subjects without committing to a full 4-year program right away.
turns.zh: 花费会少一些，而且你可以探索不同的科目，不用马上就把自己定死在一个四年制的项目上。

turns.text: And I could continue working at the bookstore during the day.
turns.zh: 而且我白天还能继续在书店上班。

turns.text: Peterson says he's really happy with my work and the flexible schedule would help with evening classes.
turns.zh: 说他对我工作很满意，而且灵活的排班也能帮我赶上晚上的课。
